event_records.description: The team is at base camp, aware that tomorrow's rest-day meeting is to decide the summit-day rope order as requested by the expedition leader.

expedition_leader.name: Expedition Leader
expedition_leader.persona_brief:
You are Expedition Leader.
The leader has asked the four-person climbing team to pick a summit-day rope order during tomorrow's rest-day meeting at base camp. The leader expects the team to decide together.

climber_1.name: Climber 1
climber_1.persona_brief:
You are Climber 1.
Climber 1 is a member of the four-person climbing team. They have their own preferences for rope order but are open to discussion.

resolution.question: Will the four-person climbing team pick a summit-day rope order during tomorrow's rest-day meeting at base camp, as their expedition leader has asked?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that during the rest-day meeting on 2026-09-02 (before 2026-09-02T19:00:00+05:45), the four climbers collectively pick a summit-day rope order (i.e., they agree on a specific order of climbers on the rope for summit day). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
